title: Castlevania: Symphony of the Night - Abandoned Mines
description:
The Abandoned Mines background from Castlevania: Symphony of the Night on PS1.

Notes:

- That's using FG1, FG2, BG1, BG2 and BG3, only leaving FG3 free.
- Recommended V-Scroll: Slow 2 (Only with the Lunar Magic latest version) and H-Scroll: Variable for the background's scrolling.
- That must be used ONLY for Vertical levels.
